concerns.text: The specification requires memory usage to stay ≤ 7 GB (SC‑001), yet no task in the list measures, monitors, or enforces this constraint. Without an explicit verification step, the memory‑usage acceptance criterion is effectively dropped.

The implementation plan (see plan.md) includes a finite‑size N‑sweep methodology (methodology‑7cd8bfa6), but the tasks document provides no corresponding task to perform this analysis. This leaves the methodological requirement orphaned and violates the spec’s completeness.
